summary: Smoke test of imported GiftsDates24 repo (exact copy, JWT login). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_import_smoke.py — admin login (giftsdates@gmail.com / Admin@GD24!), /auth/me, regular user login (testuser@giftsdates.com / Test@12345), new user registration via POST /api/auth/register, and GET on /users/browse, /wallet/balance, /dates/mine, /matches, /admin/users, /admin/stats, /admin/overview all return non-5xx with valid data. Frontend: Landing page loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with original luxury-dating design (hero image, Elena card, feature cards, footer). Login modal (data-testid auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button) authenticates admin and redirects to /browse with 'Welcome back!' toast. /admin loads full admin panel with Payouts / Verifications / Reports / Dates / Support / Live locations / Prices / Translations tabs. Regular user navigation verified: /browse (shows seeded profiles — Test User 28 London + Test Import 28 New York), /profile, /wallet (Top up / Withdraw / Monthly Spin & Win), /dates, /matches, /chats all render without JS errors. Signup page (/auth after clicking nav-register-button) renders complete multi-field form with all expected testids (email, password, language, name, birth day/month/year, gender, interest, orientation, location box, bio, phone, SMS toggle, consent). Language switcher (Radix dropdown nav-language-switcher-select) opens list of 20+ languages and switching to Deutsch instantly re-translates header, CTAs and hero copy (verified strings: Loslegen / Anmelden / Registrieren / Finde deinen Seelenverwandten überall auf der Welt). Logout (data-testid nav-logout-button) ends session and redirects to /auth. No console or page errors observed on any route.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /auth/login (982-995) correctly strips 'password' and '_id' from the user dict in response and auto-reactivates PAUSED accounts on login — matches repo-intended behaviour.

server.py /auth/register (898-980) hashes password via hash_pwd before insert, prevents duplicate emails (400), logs each registration to db.new_users_list, and sends an admin notification email — all original logic preserved from repo.

ADMIN_EMAILS env resolves is_admin for giftsdates@gmail.com correctly; /admin route is reachable in the SPA and renders the full admin shell. No seed-admin password drift observed (previous iteration_14 referenced Admin@12345 but the correct current admin password per /app/memory/test_credentials.md is Admin@GD24! and it works).
